name: live-e2e-codex
//: The live codex suite (scripts/e2e-codex.sh, with the shared scripts/e2e-lib.sh and the scripts/e2e-mcp-server.py fixture): drives the real codex CLI (network, a model call, a credential) against the release binary. Out of the gate entirely — its only target is live, which no gate recipe names — and run by .github/workflows/e2e-codex.yml through `just test-codex`. The scripts stay in scripts/ (owned by the scripts project); they are this target's inputs, so a change to them reaches this project.
